description: This file defines the Vtiger_Cron class, which provides an API for managing cron tasks, including scheduling, updating, and retrieving information about scheduled jobs in the Vtiger CRM system.

classes.name: Vtiger_Cron
classes.description: Class providing API to manage scheduled cron tasks in the Vtiger CRM platform.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the cron task.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the cron task.

methods.name: getFrequency
methods.description: Returns the frequency interval between task runs.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the task.

methods.name: getLastStart
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the task last started.

methods.name: getLastEnd
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the task last ended.

methods.name: getLastEndDateTime
methods.description: Returns the formatted display date and time when the task last ended.

methods.name: getLastStartDateTime
methods.description: Returns the formatted display date and time when the task last started.

methods.name: getTimeDiff
methods.description: Calculates and returns the duration between the last start and end times.

methods.name: getHandlerFile
methods.description: Returns the handler file associated with this cron task.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the module name associated with this cron task.

methods.name: getSequence
methods.description: Returns the sequence number of the cron task.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the cron task.

methods.name: isRunnable
methods.description: Determines if the task is ready to run based on its status and timing.

methods.name: statusEqual
methods.description: Checks if the current status matches a given value.

methods.name: isRunning
methods.description: Checks if the task is currently marked as running.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the task is enabled.

methods.name: isDisabled
methods.description: Checks if the task is disabled.

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of the cron task.

methods.name: updateFrequency
methods.description: Updates the execution frequency of the task.

methods.name: markRunning
methods.description: Marks the task as running and updates timestamps.

methods.name: markFinished
methods.description: Marks the task as finished and updates timestamps.

methods.name: setBulkMode
methods.description: Sets the bulk execution mode.

methods.name: inBulkMode
methods.description: Returns whether the task is in bulk mode.

methods.name: hadTimedout
methods.description: Detects if the task was started but never finished, indicating a timeout.

methods.name: querySilent
methods.description: Executes SQL queries silently, suppressing errors.

methods.name: initializeSchema
methods.description: Initializes the database schema for storing cron tasks.

methods.name: nextSequence
methods.description: Calculates the next sequence number for a new cron task.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new cron task with specified parameters.

methods.name: deregister
methods.description: Removes a cron task from the schedule.

methods.name: listAllActiveInstances
methods.description: Lists all active (not disabled) cron task instances.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves a cron task instance by name.

methods.name: getInstanceById
methods.description: Retrieves a cron task instance by ID.

methods.name: listAllInstancesByModule
methods.description: Lists all cron tasks associated with a specific module.
